info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Authorization Reversals API
info.description: The Card Authorization Reversals API enables users to manage the reversal of card authorization transactions efficiently. Businesses can utilize this API to initiate reversals for specific authorizations identified by the authorization ID. This functionality is essential for scenarios such as processing refunds or correcting transaction errors. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors seeking to maintain accurate card transaction records and enhance customer satisfaction through timely resolution of authorization issues.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to reverse a specific card authorization identified by its unique ID. Upon successful reversal, the authorization will be canceled, and the funds will be returned to the cardholder's account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a reversal for a specific card authorization identified by CARD-400045. It must include the necessary parameters to process the reversal.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.
